comment: The reverb is a Freeverb arrangement, eight parallel combs of 1116 to 1617 samples into four series allpasses (src/RipleyDSP.hpp:44-70). DECAY sets the comb feedback to 0.5 + decay * 0.485 and TONE sets the damping coefficient to 0.05 + tone * 0.9 (src/RipleyDSP.hpp:131, 137). ROOM lengthens extra read offsets of up to 400 samples and scales the input by 0.3 + room * 1.4; the chaos signal shifts those offsets by up to 55 samples (src/RipleyDSP.hpp:138-166). Both reverb processors take both input jacks, with a flag choosing which side they render (src/Ovomorph.cpp:322-330). The panel prints ROOM, TONE, DECAY, MIX, CHAOS and RATE over the knobs and again over the CV jacks, then CHAOS and S&H over the two CV outputs; the four audio jacks carry no lettering. Lettering is drawn in code at src/Ovomorph.cpp:403-474.
